headlines.title: Ultium Cells to upgrade Spring Hill plant for prismatic LMR cells
headlines.summary: Combined investment for the LMR programme and its LFP energy storage system (ESS) production, together with facility improvements, will reach $1bn by 2030.

headlines.title: Why GM's joint venture battery plant upgrade is key and will add jobs
headlines.summary: Ultium Cells said on Sept. 29 that its Spring Hill facility will be the first to produce lithium manganese rich (LMR) battery cells for future GM EVs.

headlines.title: How Mark Reuss says GM is facing today's automotive headwinds
headlines.summary: GM President Mark Reuss spoke onstage at Automotive News Congress on Sept. 29, being held in General Motors’ headquarters, Hudson’s Detroit.

headlines.title: What Does Ford Motor (F) Michigan Battery Lead Mean For Its EV Supply Chain?
headlines.summary: Ford Motor (NYSE:F) is under political fire over its use of Chinese battery technology at a Michigan plant that is already operating. General Motors is pushing sodium-ion battery research to build U.S. battery capacity and limit reliance on Chinese suppliers. The two Detroit automakers are intensifying efforts to secure domestic battery supply chains for future electric vehicle production.

headlines.title: Stellantis Falls 4% With Canadian Labor Standoff Unresolved; Ford and General Motors Dip
headlines.summary: A Canadian labor standoff has Stellantis stock in freefall while Ford and General Motors barely flinch, and the fight over a factory that builds no cars could soon threaten plants that do.

description: General Motors Company designs, builds, and sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts worldwide. It operates through GM North America, GM International, and GM Financial segments. The company markets its vehicles primarily under the Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, GMC, Baojun, and Wuling brand names. In addition, it sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts through retail dealers, distributors and dealers, as well as to fleet customers, including daily rental car companies, commercial fleet customers, leasing companies, and governments. Further, the company offers various range of after-sale services through dealer network, such as maintenance, light repairs, collision repairs, vehicle accessories, and extended service warranties. Additionally, it provides automotive financing; and software-enabled services and subscriptions. General Motors Company was founded in 1908 and is based in Detroit, Michigan.
